title: 공사장 표지판 읽기: 여기로 지나갈 수 있어요?
objective: By the end, you can read a construction or no-entry sign. You can find whether you can pass, the dates and hours of the work, and the way around.
summary: Learners read a Korean road-construction sign and find out what is closed, for how long, and which way to go.
note: The sign on this sheet is a sample. The office name and dates are made up.

task.title: Read the signs
task.line: Use the words from page 1 to find the information each sign gives, then choose, answer, or write.

items.text: Work is going on here now.
People and cars cannot pass through.
You cannot go into this place.
The first day and the last day of the work.
The time of day when workers are working.
This part of the sign is for people who are walking, not for cars.
Take another way to get past the closed part.
A polite apology. It does not give you any information.
items.example: 엘리베이터 점검 중입니다. 불편을 드려 죄송합니다.

sections.heading: Reading tip
paragraphs: Look for three things: what is closed (통행 금지, 출입 금지), when (기간 is the dates, 시간 is the hours), and where to go (돌아가세요, 통로).
The mark ~ means "from ... to." On real signs you may see 공사중 without a space. It means the same as 공사 중.

exercises: Choose the right word (출입 금지 / 공사 기간): 이 건물 안에는 들어가면 안 돼요. 문에 ____(이)라고 적혀 있어요.
Read the sign and answer: ① 「공사 시간: 오전 8시 ~ 오후 5시」 What time does the work stop each day? ② 「공사 기간: 3월 4일 ~ 3월 15일」 Is there work on March 20? (Yes / No)
Yes or No — can you go this way? ① 「출입 금지」 ② 「공사 중 · 보행자는 오른쪽 통로로 가세요」 You are walking. Can you take the path on the right?
Fill in the blank with 주의 or 위험: ① 바닥에 물이 있어요. 미끄러워요. ____하세요. ② 앞에 큰 구멍이 있어요. ____한 곳이에요. 가까이 가지 마세요.
Answer in Korean: Your friend asks, 「이 길로 갈 수 있어요?」 The sign says 「통행 금지 · 왼쪽으로 돌아가세요」.
answers: ① 오후 5시 (5 p.m.) ② No (the work ends on March 15)
아니요, 통행 금지예요. 왼쪽으로 돌아가세요. (아니요, 못 가요. 왼쪽으로 돌아가요.)
